questions.prompt: f(x) = x² - 8x + 12. Write f in factored form and in vertex form. Give the zeros, the vertex, and the axis of symmetry.
questions.prompt_markup:
f(x) = x² - 8x + 12.
Write f in factored form and in vertex form. Give the zeros, the vertex, and the axis of symmetry.
questions.correct_answer: (x - 2)(x - 6) and (x - 4)² - 4; zeros 2 and 6; vertex (4, -4); axis x = 4
questions.grading_note: Form required: both forms and all three features.

questions.prompt: A company's profit is P(x) = -2x² + 120x - 1,000 dollars when it charges x dollars. Complete the square to find the price that gives the most profit, and the greatest profit.
questions.prompt_markup:
A company's profit is P(x) = -2x² + 120x - 1,000 dollars when it charges x dollars.
Complete the square to find the price that gives the most profit, and the greatest profit.
questions.correct_answer: P(x) = -2(x - 30)² + 800; a price of $30 gives the greatest profit, $800.
questions.grading_note: Form required: the completed square, the price, and the profit. -2(x² - 60x + 900) + 1,800 - 1,000.
